reasons_add: Al-Qurtubi explicitly calls the causal expression an accusative complement.
Ibn Jinni explicitly prefers the nearer verb and rejects attaching the expression to both verbs together.
Ibn Jinni reports this alternative with the object of تولى left implicit.
Ibn Jinni describes al-Hasan's question as incredulous and supplies the omitted verb from عبس وتولى.
Ibn Jinni describes al-Hasan's opening as madd, with the stop after وتولى.
Al-Qurtubi gives the fuller name Amr ibn Qays ibn Zaida ibn al-Asamm and identifies him as Khadija's maternal cousin.
Al-Qurtubi names his mother Atika daughter of Amir of Makhzum.
Urwa's account through Malik and Hisham says Ibn Umm Maktum asked to be brought near. Al-Tirmidhi calls the version from Aisha gharīb, as al-Qurtubi reports.
